messages:
maria: quick sync 12 who owns the residency decision when a request could be served by Dedicated, Hosted, or fallthrough to Private? trying to avoid double-eviction races / conflicting backfills.
dan: control plane expresses policy intent, runtime enforces. but we need a clearer handshake for capabilities vs preferences.
lee: Agreed. current gap: no concise signal for latency vs cost vs isolation. can we add a small manifest hint? e.g. `residency.hint: latency|cost|isolation`
ash: (ash) +1 on hint. also need a capability probe so runtime can return an allowed-variants list instead of us assuming compatibility.
maria: proposal: two-step probe: 1) controlplane -> runtime: "candidate variants"; 2) runtime -> controlplane: "allowed variants" + opt-in reason codes (e.g. kvm-missing, quant-incompat)
sam: if allowed-variants empty, runtime should return a ranked fallback suggestion (region, cheaper model, or queue). important to include expected added latency estimate.
lee: also want an observable field so Console can show why a request fell back. something like: `fallback.reason_code` + `fallback.estimated_extra_ms`
ash: +:thumbsup: If we standardize the codes, post-hoc analysis and alerts (regressions) get way easier.
maria: edge-case: Dedicated evictions during scale-down. who initiates migration to Hosted? controlplane can request immediate rebind, but runtime needs a grace period for KV cache flush. we should add `eviction_grace_ms` on the manifest binding.
dan: thumbs. also add a small status enum for "probe_state": `ok | degraded | incompatible | unknown` so we don't treat unknown as safe to failover.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: residency-probe-v1 rolling out to infra-alpha (10% of requests) :rocket:
sam: one more: include a compact probe payload, e.g.:
``
probe_request: { model: "gptx-4", seq_len: 1024, quant: "int8" }
probe_response: { allowed: ["gptx-4-q8", "gptx-4-q4"], state: "degraded", reason_codes: ["quant-drop"] }
``
lee: nice. keep payload tiny so probes are cheap and safe.
maria: ok action items: (1) draft protocol RFC for candidate/allowed handshake + reason codes, (2) add residency.hint and eviction_grace_ms to manifest schema, (3) wire probe_state to Console telemetry. i'll draft RFC and ping for reviews tomorrow.
dan: ping me on PR for the reason-code list.
ash: i'll start a short doc with suggested reason codes and priority mapping.
maria: thanks all 12 keeping this small will help rollout.
